headline: New Africa Credit Rating Agency Targets First Sovereign Assessments
summary: Africa Credit Rating Agency (AfCRA) is a new ratings firm seeking to challenge the influence of global credit rating agencies, targeting its first sovereign assessments by March.
why: The emergence of regional credit rating agencies aims to provide alternative risk evaluations for African sovereign debt, potentially reshaping borrowing costs and investment flows.

impacts.name: African Sovereign Debt Market
impacts.why: New ratings assessments could alter debt pricing perception.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
